descriptions.campaigns_delete-sequence-step: Permanently delete one step from a campaign's email sequence. Required: id (the sequence-step ID, not the campaign ID). Destructive and irreversible: the step and its variants are removed and remaining steps keep their order. Use campaigns_sequence-steps_list first to find the step ID.
descriptions.campaigns_list-schedule-templates: List the workspace's saved sending-schedule templates (reusable day/time windows that can be applied to campaigns). Read-only, takes no parameters. Use this to discover an existing template before assigning a schedule, rather than defining sending windows by hand per campaign.
descriptions.campaigns_pause_campaign: Pause a running campaign so it stops sending new emails until resumed. Required: id (campaign ID). Partial update: only the campaign's run state changes; sequence, leads, and senders are left intact. Prefer this over deleting a campaign when you only want to halt sending temporarily.
descriptions.campaigns_schedule_get-campaign: Fetch the sending schedule (active days, time windows, and timezone) for one campaign. Required: id (campaign ID). Read-only. Use this to inspect when a campaign is allowed to send before pausing, resuming, or editing its cadence.
descriptions.campaigns_sequence-steps_list: List the ordered email steps that make up one campaign's sequence, including each step's A/B variants. Required: id (campaign ID). Read-only. Use this to get a step's ID before editing or deleting it, or to audit the sequence structure.
descriptions.custom-variables_create: Create a custom variable (a merge tag usable in email copy and personalization). Required: name. A variable must exist before it can be referenced as a merge tag in a sequence step, so call this first when introducing a new personalization field.
descriptions.custom-variables_list: List all custom variables (merge tags) defined in the current workspace. Read-only, takes no parameters. Use this to check which personalization fields already exist before creating a new one or before writing merge tags into sequence copy.
descriptions.tags_attach-to-campaigns: Attach one or more existing tags to one or more campaigns in a single call. Required: tag_ids (array) and campaign_ids (array). The tags must already exist (create them with the tags create command first). Use this for bulk-tagging campaigns; use tags_attach-to-leads to tag leads instead.
descriptions.tags_attach-to-leads: Attach one or more existing tags to one or more leads in a single call. Required: tag_ids (array) and lead_ids (array). The tags must already exist before attaching. Use this for bulk-tagging leads; use tags_attach-to-campaigns to tag campaigns instead.
descriptions.tags_delete: Permanently delete one custom tag from the workspace. Required: id (tag ID). Destructive: the tag is removed and detached from every campaign and lead it was attached to. Use tags_list to find the tag ID first.
descriptions.tags_list: List every custom tag defined in the current workspace. Read-only, takes no parameters. Use this to discover a tag's ID before attaching, detaching, or deleting it, or to audit which tags exist.
descriptions.webhook-events_send-test: Send a test webhook event to your configured webhook endpoints so you can verify delivery and payload handling without waiting for a real event. Optional: event (the event name to simulate; defaults to a sample event when omitted). Side effect: this triggers an outbound HTTP call to your endpoints.
descriptions.workspaces_list: List all workspaces visible to the current token. Read-only, takes no parameters. Requires a super-admin token; a regular workspace token will be rejected. Use this to discover workspace IDs when managing more than one workspace.
